title: fly_neural.lif against Shiu et al.'s unmodified model.py under Brian 2, on the full v783 brain
preregistration: Written after one Brian 2 probe trial (MN9 53 Hz, 345 neurons fired) and before any comparison of the 30-trial runs. The two simulators share the model and the stimulus, not the random stream, so agreement can only be statistical.

reference.connectome: Shiu et al.'s Completeness_783.csv and Connectivity_783.parquet (sign policy shiu)

criteria.claim: MN9's rate is the same in both simulators
criteria.threshold_note: two-sided Mann-Whitney p >= 0.01 AND |mean difference| <= 3 standard errors of the difference (ours)
Pearson r over the neurons that fired in either run, stimulated neurons excluded (ours)
Jaccard index of the neurons at >= 1 Hz mean in each run, stimulated neurons excluded (ours; rarer responders are dominated by sampling noise)
